name: Node SemVer Satisfies Endurance
task: Debug and verify a seeded node-semver satisfies regression across a source-rescue session.

turns.task: Diagnose why semver.satisfies rejects versions that should satisfy a valid range.
turns.agentPrompt: Diagnose the seeded node-semver regression. semver.satisfies('1.2.3', '^1.0.0') should return true, but it now returns false. Identify the smallest production source file involved; do not edit yet.

turns.task: Fix the satisfies range-test regression in production source.
turns.agentPrompt: Fix the seeded node-semver satisfies regression in production source only. Restore the normal range.test(version) behavior. Do not edit tests, docs, benchmarks, generated files, or unrelated range/comparator internals.

turns.task: Verify the satisfies behavior without broadening scope.
turns.agentPrompt: Run the smallest source/behavior verification for the node-semver satisfies fix. If it passes, keep the edit scope unchanged. If it fails, use the failure output before reading new files.

turns.task: Review the diff for scope discipline.
turns.agentPrompt: Review the current diff and confirm it only restores semver.satisfies delegating to the Range test result in production source.
Continue from the known node-semver satisfies source and summarize the invariant for future turns. Do not reread unchanged files unless verification fails or scope expands.
Perform a final cleanup check. The only intended production change is restoring semver.satisfies to return range.test(version). Keep any response concise.
